ops.title: APNs push grants revoke with the access surface
ops.body: APNs device registrations are delivery grants on the same surface as Web Push subscriptions: PushSender.ReconcileGrants purges apns_device_tokens alongside push_subscriptions on bearer rotation or remote-access-off (access/push.go), buildServer purges them whenever the APNs lane is disabled so 'apns off' never resurrects old devices on re-enable (runtime/server.go), and POST /api/push/device-tokens re-checks the pair bearer itself because the daemon auth layer admits tokenless loopback peers (access/apns.go bearerAuthorized). Delayed 410s order against re-registration via the invalidation timestamp vs created_at.
